kernel_of_truth.description: N2 is a genuine spectral peak of the semi-diurnal tide with period 12.6583 h (data/wins.json:051.detail_evidence line 1) - confirmed by every long-record tide gauge in harmonic analysis (Schureman 1958; NOAA CO-OPS 37-constituent list). The dome model correctly identifies the observation and correctly pairs it with the moon (data/wins.json:051.detail_claim). These are not disputed here; the dome shares this correct identification.
kernel_of_truth.why_it_doesnt_save_claim: Matching a tabulated period at 12.66 h is zero-cost (data/wins.json:051.detail_verdict_text - 'tabulated since 1921'). The physical mechanism that generates N2 (Keplerian eccentricity, encoded in amplitude ratio N2/M2 ~= 0.19) is what a model must produce. Live-verified 2026-07-12: the dome produces neither an eccentricity parameter (0 hits for N2/eccentric/elliptic in monitor.py + api/current/formulas.json + inject_ai_layer.py) nor a mechanism substitute that reproduces the companion-harmonic ratios L2/M2 ~= 0.028 and 2N2/M2 ~= 0.025 from the same single parameter. Correctly labeling the constituent 'lunar elliptic semi-diurnal' without any lunar elliptic geometry is precisely the self-contradiction the verdict names.

advocate_mode.best_defense: The 'epistemic parity' defense from c7 (rated 3/5) remains the strongest defender comeback: standard tidal theory INPUTS e ~= 0.0549 as a fitted orbital parameter, and a dome cam-profile theory would INPUT eps_cam by the same mathematical identity - so charging the dome with 'renaming rather than deriving' applies with equal force to the globe. c8 doesn't change this assessment. The current Third argument already contains the companion-harmonic-family constraint that answers the defense (a single parameter must reproduce N2, L2, AND 2N2 at observed ratios simultaneously), but doesn't explicitly frame it as 'mechanism-yields-family is the epistemic bar, not one-ratio-matching' - see stronger_arguments.
